validation_notes: Processed 8 CSV people for POLY. Checked 1 local document: MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/POLY/Polymetal_AR24.pdf. Completed 8 person-level research rounds plus one ticker overview note. Education was not confirmed for HE Abdulsalam Al Murshidi; all other CSV people have education confirmed mainly by the official 2024 Solidcore report. The main conflict is temporal: CSV/current page lists HE Abdulsalam Al Murshidi as Chair and Omar Bahram as Vice-Chair, while 2024 sources show Omar Bahram as Chair and do not include HE Abdulsalam on the 2024 board. AIFC records HE Abdulsalam/Abdul Sallam Mohamed Abdullah Al Murshidi as director only from 01-06-2026. Abdulmonem Al-Murshidi, who joined in January 2025, was treated as a distinct/non-2024 profile and excluded from the CSV person facts. Weaker sources such as MarketScreener, Equilar, The Org and advisory-board pages were used only as corroboration, not to override official 2024 or registry evidence. No confirmed scholarly publication set, patents or h-index were found for the target people; Janat Berdalina's book is retained only as professional output. Search is considered complete because the local document was checked first, the official 2024 report contains full biographies for the seven 2024 directors/CEO, AGM/AIFC sources resolve board composition, and the remaining major uncertainty is explicitly limited to the post-2024 Abdulsalam role and missing education. QUALITY-PASS ROUND 1 (2026-07-31): step-0 git-baseline check confirmed the on-disk file matched git HEAD (commit f973022, already post-restoration) with no further regression to undo. Fixed a systemic desync: qualification_degree was null on all 15 education/degrees entries despite an earlier addendum note claiming it had been populated; normalized all 15 against the fixed ten-value enum using the already-cited degree_or_qualification text and REFINEMENT.md rules (14 filled, 1 left null -- Ecole Normale, no stated level).
